notes.title: Update Notes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We’ve got a small but sweet update to make your tiny house adventures even smoother. Here’s what’s new:

- Fixed gaps around doors
- Added color tooltips to display their names
- Fixed NPC clothing in the auction scene
- Added a shortcut for fast travel
- Updated demolish indicators

Thanks for playing and for all your feedback! Keep building, and enjoy the update! 🚀🏡

notes.title: Update Notes!
notes.notes:
Hello! Yesterday, we released an update for our game. The highlight of this update is the introduction of perks! 🎉

Next week, we’ll focus on addressing small requests and fixing issues reported here and on Discord. 

Wishing everyone a Happy New Year and a year full of gaming fun! 🥳

 The perk system has been added.
 A route display feature has been added to the map tab.
 Fixed the issue where unbreakable walls could be broken.


Note: If you’re enjoying the game, please consider supporting us by leaving a review! 😊

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:

In this update, we've improved the map tab a bit to make it easier to navigate around the city. Right now, we're working on some perks. We hope to finish them this week and send out another update. Have a great weekend!


 Making the map tab more interactive
 Fast travel
 Route planning through the map tab

Note: If you’re enjoying the game, please don’t forget to leave a review, it really helps us out! 😊

notes.title: Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
We’ve just released an update for the game, and here’s what’s new:

 Added a 3D background to the main menu.
 Updated loading screen backgrounds.
 Separated the painting and coating modules to make things easier to understand.
 Added a roof limit for building animations.
 Fixed single-axis building animations.
 Prevented the demolition of unseen walls.
 Improved the music transition on the loading screen.

Looking ahead, our next focus will be on the Map Tab! We’re planning to make it more interactive by adding fast travel and auto-delivery features.
Lastly, we have a small request: if you’re enjoying the game, leaving a positive review would mean the world to us 😊. It helps us stay motivated and improves the game’s visibility.
Thank you for your support, and have a great weekend!

notes.title: Back to the Community: A Quick Update from the Developers
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I am one of the developers of the game. We were very busy during the publishing time, there were so many tasks. I will be more active in the community from now on. We are a five-person, 0-budget indie team. I see from the recent comments that there are a lot of complaints about AI, we will try some creative solutions for that, and I hope we will handle it. For other bugs in the comments, some have already been fixed, and the rest have been added to our roadmap. We hope to publish the game without any bugs and so polished on the full version. Thanks for support 😊

Recent Fixes and Improvements:

 Accidental painting of side walls: Added a delay to prevent this.
 Placing items under shelves: This has been resolved.
 Paint auto-purchase in quest panel: Fixed for better control.
 Improved house placement: More tolerance for placing tiny houses.
 Painting behind objects: Now allowed for better accessibility.
 Turning while on stairs: Added this functionality.
 Z-fighting issues: Resolved between build module indicators and quest indicators.


We’re excited to keep improving the game with your input—stay tuned for more updates!

Our next priorities will be:

 Fixing issues with certain alphabets in some languages.

We are working hard to prepare these improvements and plan to release the next update soon. Stay tuned!
